To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

process management is an approach to manage organizations and processes that is based on a process orientation and a process view, and that process management can be implemented in a functional organization by introducing a process management structure and by introducing a process orientation and process view.
process management is implemented by the introduction of a process management structure and that the implementation of process management is a continuous process.
the implementation of process management is a complex and difficult undertaking.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the implementation of a management approach in which the organization’s processes become the focal point of attention.
the implementation of process management in three Swedish organizations.
the organizational implications of process management and the relationship between a functional organization and a more process‐based organization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the studied organizations have implemented process management, but the process perspective has not become the dominant perspective in the organizations.
process management can be implemented in an organization with a functional organization structure, but that it is important to consider the organizational implications of such an implementation.

a process management structure can be implemented in a functional organization without a complete transformation, but it requires an extensive change process and a long time to be successful.Originality/value – The paper provides an empirical study of the organizational implications and change processes when implementing process management.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the organizations have implemented a process management structure in their functional organizational structure.
process management is a management approach that focuses on the management of processes and the management of the organization as a whole.
we have shown the importance of a process perspective in organizations.
The main takeaway from our work is that

process management is a complex and demanding undertaking, and the organizational implications are far from trivial.Research limitations/implications – This paper provides an in‐depth analysis and understanding of the organizational implications when organizations implement process management.

process management is a way of working that requires the support of managers and individuals, and that it is not possible to achieve process management through a process management structure only.Research limitations/implications – The study is limited in that the cases studied were Swedish organizations.
process management can be implemented in a way that supports and strengthens the functional organization, rather than being a substitute for it.
